messages.content: 请只输出 Python 源码。不得使用 imports、class 定义或测试代码。

Return only Python source, without imports, classes, tests, or explanatory text. Implement merge_intervals(busy) and free_windows(busy, start, end). busy is a list of numeric (a,b) pairs representing half-open intervals [a,b). merge_intervals returns sorted tuples, merges overlapping or touching intervals, ignores zero-length intervals, and raises ValueError for reversed intervals. free_windows validates end >= start, clips busy intervals to [start,end), and returns sorted maximal free intervals as tuples. An empty query window returns []. Neither function may mutate its inputs. Use Python builtins only. Include useful docstrings and clear handling of edge cases.
